name: Reset Day
source:
Vaporwave and robofeels. Slice of life. See the world through the eyes of cool posthuman machines, and effect some change where it's needed. Point-and-click adventure goodness. 

[From [url=https://kayedrgn.itch.io/reset-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
蒸汽波、机器人的情感，以及日常生活。从酷炫的后人类机器视角观察世界，在需要的地方推动一些改变。尽享点击式冒险的乐趣。

[摘自[url=https://kayedrgn.itch.io/reset-day]itch.io[/url]]
